## Invitations

During East City 2019 Q3, 519 people were invited to participate in the outreach activity. A total of 305 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 58.8 per cent. These figures provide a summary of participation during the reporting period and show attendance in relation to the number of invitations issued. The information can support routine review of invitation and attendance activity.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0. The number of reminders issued was also 0. These figures indicate that neither SMS messages nor reminders formed part of the recorded contact activity for this reporting period. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments as part of ongoing follow-up. This activity is separate from the SMS and reminder figures reported above and supports continued efforts to maintain contact and encourage future engagement.
